news.q: Joshua Kutryk did a spacewalk on Oct. 29. Counting him, how many Canadian astronauts have now walked in space?
news.fact: He helped install the 7th of 8 new solar arrays on the station.

news.q: Microsoft reported on Oct. 28 that its quarterly revenue was how many billion dollars, to the nearest billion?
news.fact: Revenue rose 19% from a year earlier, as its Azure cloud grew about 48%.

easy.q: How many Sanderson sisters are in Hocus Pocus?
easy.fact: Winifred, Mary and Sarah, played by Bette Midler, Kathy Najimy and Sarah Jessica Parker.

easy.q: What's par on most 18-hole championship golf courses?
easy.fact: That's usually four par 3s, ten par 4s and four par 5s.

easy.q: How many U.S. states are bigger than Texas?
easy.fact: Alaska is more than twice the size of Texas.

easy.q: How many times did Henry VIII get married?
easy.fact: Kids remember the wives' fates with a rhyme: divorced, beheaded, died, divorced, beheaded, survived.

easy.q: How many heroes team up in the first Avengers movie (2012)?
easy.fact: Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye.

medium.q: How many Ballon d'Or awards has Lionel Messi won?
medium.fact: That's a record; his last came in 2023.

medium.q: How many floors does the Empire State Building have?
medium.fact: It was the world's tallest building for nearly 40 years.

medium.q: How many Rocky movies did Sylvester Stallone make, not counting the Creed films?
medium.fact: The first Rocky won Best Picture.

medium.q: How old was John F. Kennedy when he was elected president?
medium.fact: He was the youngest person ever elected president.

medium.q: How many times has Taylor Swift won the Grammy for Album of the Year?
medium.fact: No artist has won it more.

hard.q: How many years did Louis XIV reign over France?
hard.fact: That's the longest reign of any monarch in European history.

hard.q: How many Oscars did The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King win?
hard.fact: It won every category it was nominated in.

hard.q: How long is the Channel Tunnel between England and France, to the nearest mile?
hard.fact: About 23 miles of it run under the sea.

hard.q: How many points did Caitlin Clark score in college, the NCAA Division I record?
hard.fact: She played four seasons at Iowa.
